stories.title: Judge not on Yankees' roster for ALDS vs. Rays
stories.summary: Aaron Judge is not on the Yankees' roster for the American League Division Series against the Rays.

stories.title: Source: Bears expected to start QB Bagent vs. Jets
stories.summary: The Bears are expected to start Tyson Bagent at quarterback against the Jets, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Mississippi State's Bothwell exits vs. Alabama after one carry
stories.summary: Mississippi State RB Fluff Bothwell, who is second in the SEC in rushing yards, carried the ball once vs. Alabama before leaving with a lower-body injury.

stories.title: WR-thin Colts lose vet Allen to groin injury ahead of London game
stories.summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen has a groin injury that will force him to sit out Sunday's game in London against the Commanders.

stories.title: 'Big shot Gabby' leads Valkyries' charge from 16 down, ousts Wings in Game 3
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 11 of her 19 points in the fourth quarter to help the Valkyries erase a 16-point second-half deficit and secure a spot in the WNBA semifinals with a 77-73 win over the Wings.
